answer: Dentate gyrus. Bad responders show the highest number of significantly differentially expressed genes vs controls in the dentate gyrus: 194 genes meet padj<0.05, lfc>0.5 and baseMean>10 (literal criterion), versus 88 in baseline blood and 15 in final blood; under the |lfc|>0.5 sensitivity variant the counts are 245 (dentate gyrus), 93 (baseline blood) and 21 (final blood). Method: the deposited DESeq2 result blocks 2/5/8 in the NormCount sheet (bad_responder vs Control per tissue, outlier-excluded DESeq2 fits) were filtered at padj<0.05 and baseMean>10; block identity and lfc signs were verified against direct group means of the count matrix.
